text.EN: Ceasefire accepted for one hour.
text.TL: Tinanggap ang tigil-putukan sa loob ng isang oras.

text.EN: Ceasefire refused.
text.TL: Tumanggi ang tigil-putukan.

text.EN: The survivor watches you carefully, ready to fight.
text.TL: Maingat kang pinagmamasdan ng survivor, handang lumaban.

responseText.EN: You ask for a short ceasefire.

text.EN: You're up. Good—we have plenty to do.
text.TL: Gising ka na. Mabuti—marami tayong gagawin.

text.EN: Morning. I already checked the perimeter.
text.TL: Umaga. Sinuri ko na ang perimeter.

text.EN: Couldn't sleep either? We may as well get started.
text.TL: Hindi rin makatulog? Maaari rin tayong magsimula.

text.EN: First light. What's the plan today?
text.TL: Unang liwanag. Ano ang plano ngayon?

text.EN: Morning. Everyone else is still asleep, so it's just us.
text.TL: Umaga. Tulog pa ang iba kaya kami na lang.

text.EN: Morning. Ready when you are.
text.TL: Umaga. Handa kung kailan ka na.

text.EN: Good, you're here. What are we doing today?
text.TL: Buti nandito ka. Ano ang ginagawa natin ngayon?

text.EN: Another day with the crew. Could be worse.
text.TL: Panibagong araw kasama ang crew. Maaaring mas masahol pa.

text.EN: Morning. Supplies are holding for now.
text.TL: Umaga. Ang mga suplay ay hawak sa ngayon.

text.EN: I was about to look for you. What's up?
text.TL: Hinahanap na sana kita. Anong meron?

text.EN: We made it through the day. That's something.
text.TL: Nalampasan natin ang araw. May halaga iyon.

text.EN: Hey. Need a hand before we wrap up?
text.TL: Hey. Kailangan ng kamay bago tayo magtapos?

text.EN: Long day, but I'm still ready if you need me.
text.TL: Mahabang araw, pero handa pa rin ako kung kailangan mo ako.

text.EN: Everyone accounted for?
text.TL: Lahat ng tao accounted para sa?

text.EN: The light's fading. We should finish up soon.
text.TL: Kumukupas na ang liwanag. Dapat na tayong magtapos.

text.EN: Evening. Perimeter looks clear.
text.TL: Gabi. Mukhang malinaw ang perimeter.

text.EN: Need me for something before night watch?
text.TL: Kailangan mo ba ako bago ang pagbabantay sa gabi?

text.EN: We're all still here. I'll call that a good day.
text.TL: Narito pa rin tayong lahat. Ituturing ko iyong magandang araw.

text.EN: Keep it quiet. The others are settling down.
text.TL: Manahimik ka. Umayos na yung iba.

text.EN: I can take first watch if you need the rest.
text.TL: Maaari akong kumuha ng unang panonood kung kailangan mo ang iba pa.

text.EN: You're supposed to be resting. What's wrong?
text.TL: Dapat nagpapahinga ka. Ano ang problema?

text.EN: Quiet night so far. Let's keep it that way.
text.TL: Tahimik na gabi hanggang ngayon. Panatilihin natin itong paraan.

text.EN: I'm on watch. Did you need something?
text.TL: Nakabantay ako. may kailangan ka ba?

text.EN: Good, it's you. I heard footsteps.
text.TL: Buti, ikaw pala. Nakarinig ako ng mga yabag.

text.EN: Can't sleep? Pull up a chair, but keep your voice low.
text.TL: Hindi makatulog? Hilahin ang isang upuan, ngunit panatilihing mahina ang iyong boses.

text.EN: You're awake early too. Everything all right?
text.TL: Gising ka rin nang maaga. Ayos ba ang lahat?

text.EN: Morning. I didn't expect to see you before sunrise.
text.TL: Umaga. Hindi ko inaasahan na makikita kita bago sumikat ang araw.

text.EN: Couldn't sleep? Neither could I.
text.TL: hindi makatulog? Hindi ko rin kaya.

text.EN: Good, it's you. What brings you over this early?
text.TL: Buti, ikaw pala. Ano ang nagdudulot sa iyo ng ganito kaaga?

text.EN: Dawn patrol, or did you need something?
text.TL: Dawn patrol, o may kailangan ka?

text.EN: Morning. Good to see a familiar face.
text.TL: Umaga. Ang sarap makakita ng pamilyar na mukha.

text.EN: Hey. How's the day treating you?
text.TL: Hey. Kumusta ang pagtrato sa iyo ng araw?

text.EN: There you are. Need a minute?
text.TL: Narito ka pala. Kailangan mo ba ng sandali?

text.EN: Morning. You look like you have something on your mind.
text.TL: Umaga. Parang may iniisip ka.

text.EN: Nice to see you made it through another night.
text.TL: Natutuwa akong makita kang nagtagumpay sa isa pang gabi.

text.EN: Hey. Been a long day?
text.TL: Hey. Isang mahabang araw?

text.EN: Good timing. I was about to settle in.
text.TL: Magandang timing. Malapit na akong tumira.

text.EN: There you are. Find anything useful today?
text.TL: Narito ka pala. May nakita ka bang kapaki-pakinabang ngayon?

text.EN: The day's winding down. What's up?
text.TL: Palubog na ang araw. Anong meron?

text.EN: You look tired. Everything okay?
text.TL: Mukha kang pagod. Ayos ka lang ba?

text.EN: Evening. Need something before we turn in?
text.TL: Gabi. Kailangan mo ng isang bagay bago tayo lumiko?

text.EN: Good, it's only you. You startled me.
text.TL: Buti, ikaw lang. Ginulat mo ako.

text.EN: Not much daylight left. Talk to me.
text.TL: Wala na masyadong liwanag ng araw. kausapin mo ako.

text.EN: Hey. Keeping watch, or just passing by?
text.TL: Hey. Nagmamasid, o dumadaan lang?

text.EN: We should keep this quiet, but I'm listening.
text.TL: Dapat tahimik lang tayo rito, pero nakikinig ako.

text.EN: Late night. What has you awake?
text.TL: Gabi na. Anong gising mo?

text.EN: It's good to see someone I recognize out here.
text.TL: Nakakatuwang makita ang isang taong kilala ko dito.

text.EN: Keep it down. Sound carries at night.
text.TL: Panatilihin ito pababa. Ang tunog ay nagdadala sa gabi.

text.EN: You all right? It's late to be wandering.
text.TL: Ayos ka lang ba? Gabi na para magpagala-gala.

text.EN: Hey. Make it quick before we draw attention.
text.TL: Hey. Bilisan mo bago tayo makatawag ng pansin.

text.EN: Hold there. I don't know you, and dawn is a strange time for introductions.
text.TL: Humawak ka dyan. Hindi kita kilala, at ang bukang-liwayway ay isang kakaibang oras para sa pagpapakilala.

text.EN: You're up before the dead settle down. Who are you?
text.TL: Gising ka bago pa manahimik ang mga patay. Sino ka?

text.EN: Easy. The light is barely up, and I wasn't expecting company.
text.TL: Madali. Bahagyang nakapatay ang ilaw, at hindi ko inaasahan ang makakasama ko.

text.EN: Morning, I suppose. Keep your hands where I can see them.
text.TL: Umaga, kumbaga. Itago ang iyong mga kamay kung saan ko sila makikita.

text.EN: First light and a new face. Tell me what you need.
text.TL: Unang liwanag at bagong mukha. Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano ang kailangan mo.

text.EN: Morning. I haven't seen you around before.
text.TL: Umaga. Hindi pa kita nakikita kanina.

text.EN: That's close enough. Start with your name.
text.TL: Malapit na yun. Magsimula sa iyong pangalan.

text.EN: New face. Are you passing through or looking for something?
text.TL: Bagong mukha. Ikaw ba ay dumadaan o may hinahanap?

text.EN: Daylight makes this easier. Who are you?
text.TL: Pinapadali ito ng liwanag ng araw. sino ka ba

text.EN: I don't recognize you. Talk, and keep it calm.
text.TL: hindi kita kilala. Mag-usap, at panatilihin itong kalmado.

text.EN: You picked a late hour to approach a stranger.
text.TL: Huli na para lumapit sa isang estranghero.

text.EN: The light is going. Say what you came to say.
text.TL: Ang ilaw ay pupunta. Sabihin mo kung ano ang gusto mong sabihin.

text.EN: I don't know you, but I'm listening.
text.TL: Hindi kita kilala, pero nakikinig ako.

text.EN: Before it gets dark, tell me who you are.
text.TL: Bago dumilim, sabihin mo sa akin kung sino ka.

text.EN: Another survivor. Friendly, I hope?
text.TL: Isa pang nakaligtas. Friendly, sana?

text.EN: Stop there. Dusk makes strangers hard to read.
text.TL: Tumigil ka dyan. Dahil sa takipsilim, mahirap basahin ang mga estranghero.

text.EN: Not much light left. Introduce yourself.
text.TL: Wala nang gaanong ilaw. Magpakilala ka.

text.EN: You surprised me. What do you want?
text.TL: Nagulat mo ako. Ano ang kailangan mo?

text.EN: Keep your voice down and tell me why you're here.
text.TL: Hinaan mo ang boses mo at sabihin sa akin kung bakit ka nandito.

text.EN: I can't make out your face. Come no closer.
text.TL: Hindi ko maaninag ang mukha mo. Huwag kang lalapit.

text.EN: It's dark out. Stay where I can see you.
text.TL: Madilim sa labas. Manatili ka kung saan kita makikita.

text.EN: A stranger walking up at night usually means trouble.
text.TL: Ang isang estranghero na naglalakad sa gabi ay karaniwang nangangahulugan ng problema.

text.EN: Keep your voice low. Who are you?
text.TL: Panatilihing mahina ang iyong boses. sino ka ba

text.EN: You chose a bad time to sneak up on someone.
text.TL: You chose a bad time to sneak up buhay someone.

text.EN: Don't move any closer. We can talk from there.
text.TL: Huwag kang lalapit. Maaari tayong mag-usap mula doon.

text.EN: You're awake already. I was hoping you'd sleep a little longer.
text.TL: You're awake already. I was hoping you'd tulog a little longer.

text.EN: Morning, love. Come here before the day starts.
text.TL: Umaga, mahal. Halika dito bago magsimula ang araw.

text.EN: I missed you, and you were only asleep.
text.TL: Namiss kita, tulog ka lang.

text.EN: First light looks better with you here.
text.TL: Mas maganda ang unang liwanag kapag kasama ka rito.

text.EN: Couldn't sleep without checking on everyone, could you?
text.TL: Hindi makatulog nang hindi sinusuri ang lahat, hindi ba?

text.EN: Morning, love. You sleep all right?
text.TL: Umaga, mahal. Matulog ka na okay?

text.EN: There you are. I was starting to miss you.
text.TL: Narito ka pala. Nagsisimula na kitang ma-miss.

text.EN: Good morning. Stay close today, okay?
text.TL: Magandang umaga po. Manatiling malapit ngayon, okay?

text.EN: Seeing you first thing still makes this place feel almost normal.
text.TL: Ang una mong makita ay halos normal pa rin ang pakiramdam ng lugar na ito.

text.EN: Morning. Whatever happens today, we handle it together.
text.TL: Umaga. Kung ano man ang mangyari ngayon, sabay nating haharapin.

text.EN: There you are. I worried when you were gone so long.
text.TL: Narito ka pala. Nag-alala ako nang matagal kang wala.

text.EN: Come sit with me before the light goes.
text.TL: Halika maupo ka sa akin bago mamatay ang ilaw.

text.EN: Long day. I'm glad you're here at the end of it.
text.TL: Mahabang araw. Natutuwa akong narito ka sa dulo nito.

text.EN: You made it back. That's all I needed to see.
text.TL: Nakabalik ka. Iyon lang ang kailangan kong makita.

text.EN: The sunset almost makes this place look peaceful.
text.TL: Halos nagmumukhang payapa ang lugar na ito sa dapit-hapon.

text.EN: Stay with me a minute before night watch.
text.TL: Manatili sa akin ng isang minuto bago manood ng gabi.

text.EN: Evening, love. You look exhausted.
text.TL: Gabi, mahal. Mukha kang pagod.

text.EN: You're safe. I can breathe again.
text.TL: Ligtas ka. Muli na akong makahihinga.

text.EN: Come closer. We don't get many quiet moments.
text.TL: Lumapit ka. Hindi kami nakakakuha ng maraming tahimik na sandali.

text.EN: I saved you a place by me.
text.TL: Iniligtas kita ng isang lugar sa tabi ko.

text.EN: Can't sleep? Neither can I.
text.TL: Hindi makatulog? Hindi ko rin kaya.

text.EN: It's all right. I'm here.
text.TL: ayos lang. nandito ako.

text.EN: Come sit with me. We can keep watch together.
text.TL: Halika upo sa akin. Maaari tayong magbantay nang magkasama.

text.EN: You scared me walking around this late.
text.TL: Tinakot mo ako sa paglalakad nang ganito kagabi.

text.EN: Stay close tonight. I mean it.
text.TL: Manatili kang malapit ngayong gabi. Seryoso ako.
